extracted.name: Hot Dog Roll-Up
extracted.description: This two-minute lunch recipe for cheesy and easy hot dog wraps (aka roll-ups) rely on flour tortillas, all-beef hot dogs, and processed American cheese.
instruction_lines: Place hot dogs between 2 paper towels. Microwave on high for 20 seconds. Set aside.
Lay 1 slice processed cheese in center of each tortilla. Place 1 hot dog on top of each cheese slice.
Roll up each tortilla from one end to the other, enclosing cheese and hot dog.
Place roll-ups on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave until cheese is fully melted and tortillas warmed, 10 to 12 seconds.
